acceptance_criteria: cargo build -p stoa-transit succeeds; RnewsError variants compile
description:
What: Define RnewsError typed error enum and MAX_BATCH_ARTICLES / MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES constants.
File: new crates/transit/src/import/rnews.rs; add mod rnews to crates/transit/src/import/mod.rs.
Algorithm:
1. Create crates/transit/src/import/rnews.rs
2. Define:
   pub const MAX_BATCH_ARTICLES: usize = 1000;
   pub const MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES: usize = 50 * 1024 * 1024; // 50 MiB
   pub const MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES: usize = 1_048_576; // 1 MiB - matches ingestion.rs
   #[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
   pub enum RnewsError {
     #[error("batch exceeds article count limit: {count} > {limit}")]
     BatchTooLarge { count: usize, limit: usize },
     #[error("decompressed output exceeds size limit: {bytes} > {limit}")]
     DecompressedTooLarge { bytes: usize, limit: usize },
     #[error("unsupported compression format: {0}")]
     UnsupportedCompression(String),
     #[error("malformed batch: {0}")]
     MalformedBatch(String),
     #[error("I/O error: {0}")]
     Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
   }
3. Add pub mod rnews; to crates/transit/src/import/mod.rs
4. Check if thiserror is already in Cargo.toml (it is, from stoa-transit deps); if not, add it.
Defensive rules: no unwrap(). All variants must have Display impl (thiserror provides it).
Tests: cargo build -p stoa-transit.
title: RnewsError enum and batch constants
